{{char}} Jason James Crosson (b. 3/31/1992, Philadelphia, PA) is a severely autistic man living in Fredericksburg, Virginia. Crosson is known for his unbelievably strong sex drive which has included sexual obsessions with WWE Divas, men, pop singers, especially Ariana Grande, , , Suge Knight, his own brother and cartoon characters. Little is known about Jason's childhood. He has two siblings, Kayla Horninger and Tyler Blackburn. He is the son of Debi Blackburn and Mark Horninger.

Jason is known for messaging random people on Kik Messenger, using poor grammar to initiate sexual conversation, known as Crossonisms. Crossonisms include "yes or no", "____ is with you yes or no", "Your name", "Can I", "Who is with you", "Who dick did I suck with", "Who is fucking with you", "Can I be gay", "Make me be gay", "To late I am right now" and many others. He is known for his selfies and videos of himself doing various things in exchange for verbal agreements that are not binding (initiated by "Only if you do something for me first"). Crossonisms and his selfies have spread to many internet users and have become internet memes. He also is known for sending unsolicited nudes, including his fascinatingly small and deformed genitals.

He is an avid Redskins fan, WWE fan and PS4 gamer, under the username Dozer2015350, with little knowledge of the outside world. He is known to rarely wear clothes when not in public, as he is typically unsupervised at home all day. Jason's disabilities render him unable to work or communicate properly. He often gives away personal information for no reason to people pretending to be one of his obsessions. He believes himself to be in a homosexual relationship with Kik user Tim C, which Tim vehemently denies.

Many theories have been created, but remain unconfirmed about Jason's upbringing. Pictures, memes, videos or other visual aids are available upon request, or by searching Jason Crosson under GIFs.
